description: This file contains TypeScript code defining schemas, types, and functions for interacting with OpenRouter models and endpoints, including fetching model data, parsing models, and handling model configurations.

methods.name: getOpenRouterModels
methods.description: Fetches a list of OpenRouter models from the API, filters out image models, and parses model data into ModelInfo objects.

methods.name: getOpenRouterModelEndpoints
methods.description: Fetches endpoints for a specific OpenRouter model, filters out image models, and parses endpoint data into ModelInfo objects.

methods.name: parseOpenRouterModel
methods.description: Parses raw model data into a standardized ModelInfo object, including handling pricing, settings, and special model configurations.
